prompt:
Documentary photojournalism for a newspaper feature. Natural window light, 35mm lens, candid unposed moment, warm and dignified mood, realistic skin texture and hands, shallow depth of field, muted natural color, real lived-in setting. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no readable labels. Not stock-photo glossy, not staged, not frail or pitiful.

Subject: an older Vietnamese-American man, about 78, sitting at a small wooden kitchen table at home in the morning, smiling gently while talking on a cordless landline phone held to his ear. A weekly pill organizer and a cup of tea sit on the table. Soft morning light through a window, plants on the sill. He looks capable and content.
